## Model pricing and spend
- See OpenRouter’s input and output text-token rates, Sai’s relative credit costs, and billing details for local and account-backed models as you choose a model. - Open **Computer → Session and instructions** to see the OpenRouter spend Agent S has tracked for the selected agent. Tracking starts with new requests. - Use **Settings → Accounts → Check OpenRouter spend** to see daily, weekly, monthly, and lifetime spend for the saved key.
## Chat and sandbox
- Expand long prompts in chat and hover to copy the full prompt. - Turning off the sandbox now cancels pending startup and waits for confirmed VM shutdown so its memory can be reclaimed.
